name: shop-pot
task: Whenever the pot boils over, turn the stove down.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Response(pot_boiling, stove_fixed) captures the task's conditional rule: whenever the pot is boiling, the stove must eventually be turned down. This is rule-only, so no hard goal clause is required, and the environment guarantees stove_fixed ends pot_boiling, so the response can close.

texts: Whenever the pot is boiling, the stove is eventually turned down.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, pot_boiling&!stove_fixed) -> u1
(u1, stove_fixed) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, pot_boiling&!stove_fixed, u1) -> -1
(u1, stove_fixed, u0) -> 1
